claims.text: Lewis describes negotiated local relations, a lease and limited Zanzibar administration at Mogadishu. Omar’s appendix instead reprints a party-specific Habr Awal protection agreement, with obligations and jurisdiction bounded to its signers. The selected operative appendix date differs from the narrative date and is not the 1884 or Warsangali agreement. Treaty prescription neither supplies continuous city administration nor establishes all Somali assent; original instruments remain uncollated.
